# Submission Checklist

## Repository and tests

- [ ] The required milestone work is complete.
- [ ] Every team member has meaningful commits under their own account.
- [ ] `mvn clean test` succeeds from the command line.
- [ ] The final commit has been pushed to GitHub.
- [ ] The final commit hash is recorded in the manifest and report.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, build output, or unrelated files are included.

## Report and declarations

- [ ] The correct report version is included as `report.pdf`.
- [ ] The Team Contribution Matrix is complete.
- [ ] The AI Use Declaration is complete.
- [ ] If material AI was used, the AI Use Log is included in the report appendix.
- [ ] Commit references in the report are correct.

## Moodle package

- [ ] `repository.bundle` was created and verified.
- [ ] `submission-manifest.txt` is complete.
- [ ] The package contains the required files only.
- [ ] The ZIP opens after creation.
- [ ] The bundle can be cloned or verified.
- [ ] The correct ZIP was uploaded to the correct Moodle milestone activity.
